_readme: Unresolved product decisions surfaced by the prototype. Shown on the dashboard. Edit freely; this is Kate's list, not the models'.

decisions.title: Silent hold on 'already done'
decisions.detail: When a patient says the labs are already done and the partner never confirms within the grace period, should the service text again, or stay silent until Kate resolves the item?

decisions.title: Safety texts during a Kate pause
decisions.detail: Should clinical/staff acknowledgements (with the clinic phone and 911 language) go out while outreach is paused?

decisions.title: Overdue threshold
decisions.detail: 15-45 days is configurable; the partner must validate the number for its own order mix. Orders with a future intended due date are never overdue.

decisions.title: Identity check before order detail
decisions.detail: Today the first text names the ordering provider but no test. Should any order detail require a date-of-birth challenge first?

decisions.title: External completion attestation
decisions.detail: Kate can mark an order 'completed outside the network' with an evidence note. Who at the partner is allowed to attest, and does it count for the pilot's completion metric?
decisions.default: Kate attests; counted separately from partner-verified

decisions.title: Constrained model wording
decisions.detail: Every patient-facing sentence is a template. Allow the model to fill one bounded slot (e.g., a warmer acknowledgement) once a labeled eval exists?

decisions.title: Fewer-reminders cadence
decisions.detail: A patient who asks for fewer reminders gets exactly one more in 7 days, then the order is marked unresolved. Is one the right number?

decisions.title: Plan survives a replaced constraint
decisions.detail: When a patient replaces a constraint (e.g. 'mornings only now') and the existing walk-in plan still fits the new constraint, the plan stands without re-confirmation. Should the service re-confirm instead?
